quarterly_data.quarter: Soitec press release: Soitec Trading Update (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Guidance raised on accelerating Photonics-SOI demand, greater visibility on near-term customer requirements and the ability to adjust capacity: Q2'27 revenue now expected to grow around 50% year-on-year at constant currency and scope, versus the more than 30% guided on July 22nd, 2026. Photonics-SOI revenue now expected around 3 times the Q2'26 level (around $25m) in Q2'27, around 2.3 times the H1'26 level (around $50m) in H1'27, and between 2.5 and 3 times the FY26 level (slightly above $100m) in FY27. Expectations for the rest of the business remain broadly unchanged.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2'27 revenue growth around 50% YoY (was more than 30%); Photonics-SOI Q2'27 ~3x of ~$25m, H1'27 ~2.3x of ~$50m, FY27 2.5-3x of slightly above $100m
